_comment: model_version: the hub metadata model_version for this model; calibration: spread multipliers around the median for horizons 0-3 (1.0: no widening); flag_inputs: reliability flags of the own series as inputs; flag_train: 'drop' leaves out training windows with flagged label weeks, 'none' keeps them; val: early-stopping mode(s), 'recent' and/or 'last_season', forecasts of all modes averaged; copula: 'gaussian' (correlation of validation errors), 'independent' or 'comonotone'; sample_seed: seed of the copula draws
